cmd:
set -e
B=claude/direct-automation-expeditor-671esy
cd /root/Iryna_Karmazina && git fetch -q origin $B
cp /root/unitex-os-www/index.html /root/unitex-os-www/index.html.bak-settings
git show origin/$B:www/index.html > /root/unitex-os-www/index.html
echo "гама: $(grep -c 'function bindPalette' /root/unitex-os-www/index.html) | пароль: $(grep -c 'function bindPasswordChange' /root/unitex-os-www/index.html)"
IP=$(curl -s -4 ifconfig.me)
echo "UI $(curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://$IP/)"
echo "ендпоінт зміни пароля: $(curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST https://$IP/api/v1/auth/password/change -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}')"
